hero.title: About EGLO
hero.brightMinds: Bright minds have always been concerned with the subject of light.
hero.description:
Although the light bulb is widely believed to have been invented by Thomas Edison, scientists and inventors had already been exploring the use of electric light since the early 19th century. While the first light bulb patents were granted in 1841, Edison enabled their practical use and mass production in 1880.

At EGLO, we found our place in the history of lighting, which has been successfully developing for more than 50 years.
hero.motto: "Contemporary design, combined with high functionality, at affordable prices."
hero.mottoDescription:
This has always been, and continues to be, our motto. Keeping pace with the times, we develop and manufacture products tailored to our customers' needs. We are currently working intensively on the topic of smart lighting, bringing light and lighting into a digitally networked and easily controllable form.

Whatever the future holds for light, we will continue to deliver contemporary lighting solutions for every area of life, from Austrian Tyrol to the world.

landmark.title: Milestones
landmark.subtitle: Moments that showcase our bright history.

1969.title: Founding of EGLO
1969.description: EGLO was founded with a vision of continuous innovation and growth in the world of lighting. From the very beginning, determination, persistence, and constant development were the driving forces behind our success. Our founder, Ludwig Obwieser, began this story with passion and dedication, creating a path that still guides the brand forward today.

1976.title: First company building in Austria
1976.description: EGLO's first company building was completed in Pill, Austria, marking an important step in the company's expansion.

1986.title: Globalization
1986.description: EGLO takes its first step toward internationalization by founding a sales company in Germany. This marks the beginning of EGLO's mission to become a global brand, now present in more than 70 countries.

2016.title: Company building in Germany
2016.description: A new, modern company building opens in Arnsberg, Germany, reflecting EGLO's commitment to innovation and growth in the European market.

1994.title: First factory in Hungary
1994.description: EGLO's first factory is built in Pásztó, Hungary. The factory has grown continuously and now includes a 4-story, 14,000 m² production hall with a fully automated warehouse.

1997.title: Sustainable growth
1997.description: EGLO invests in central warehouses for fast delivery. In 1997, storage space exceeds 10,000 m³ for the first time, a trend that continues over the next 20 years, reaching 200,000 m³ by 2017.

2001.title: Production in China
2001.description: EGLO begins production in China. The office and production building cover an area of more than 120,000 m², employing more than 1,100 people and supporting global growth.

2006.title: LED technology
2006.description: EGLO introduces its first LED products, setting new standards in energy-efficient lighting. Today, almost the entire range consists of long-lasting, energy-saving LED luminaires.

2016_smart.title: Smart lighting solutions
2016_smart.description: EGLO introduces smart lighting, making homes brighter. The company continuously works on solutions for easily and intelligently controlling lighting through smart devices.

2017.title: Production in India
2017.description: A new factory in India begins operations, supporting EGLO's global supply chain and expanding production capacity in Asia.

2019.title: 50th anniversary
2019.description: EGLO celebrates 50 years of lighting innovation, with more than 70 companies worldwide and more than 80,000 luminaires produced daily across factories in Hungary, China, and India.

2021.title: Innovative logistics center in Magdeburg
2021.description: A new logistics center opens in Magdeburg, Germany, with space for approximately 76,000 pallets and more than 150 employees, further improving EGLO's European distribution.

2023.title: Opening of EGLO Lichtwelten
2023.description: The largest lighting showroom, a place where visitors can choose from a huge selection of items. On an area of about 10,000 m², a modern 3-story building was created with a total of 7,500 m² of exhibition space and 4,600 m² of outdoor space.

management.title: EGLO Management
management.subtitle: A ship cannot sail the right course without a captain and a helm. With us, this role is shared by the group and extended management.

worldwide.title: EGLO Worldwide
worldwide.subtitle: If you want to conquer the world, you have to be everywhere.
worldwide.description: Our factories in Hungary, China, and India manufacture products to satisfy our customers. To make this possible, we source ideas from around the world. These ideas are transformed into products available worldwide. Our sales companies in around 50 countries around the world are the key to this.

workingAtEglo.title: Working at EGLO
workingAtEglo.quote: A good company can grow your skills.
workingAtEglo.description:
People are organized beings. We organize ourselves into families, associations, institutions, companies, and of course, we organize ourselves. We are in relationships with one another because we cannot exist alone. Only through exchange and interaction with others can we grow and achieve things we could not do alone. That is why, at EGLO, we highly value fair collaboration.

We are convinced that everyone can contribute to building a shared and successful future.

interiorLights.name: Interior Lighting
interiorLights.description:
Perfect light for every room. Highlight the uniqueness of your room by using interior lighting. Combine soft colors, elegant furniture, and the latest smart home technology.

Every room is different — you may want to create a relaxing atmosphere in one, and work in another. Discover our wide range of interior lighting products and find your personal style.

smartLighting.name: Smart Lighting
smartLighting.description:
We have the best smart lighting solutions for your home, with our EGLO Connect and EGLO Access line.

Control your lighting via remote control or app. It's practical and easy to use, with the touch of a button.

ledLamps.name: LED Lamps
ledLamps.description:
LED offers the best lighting technology on the market. Care for our planet by using modern LED lamps.

Give up traditional bulbs — LED lamps are lighting the future. Discover a wide selection of outstanding designs for every taste.

ledStripLights.name: LED Strips
ledStripLights.description: LED strips provide indirect lighting in your home to showcase and illuminate specific pieces of furniture and décor, including bookshelves or frames.

ledPanel.name: LED Panel
ledPanel.description: LED panels provide fantastic lighting through a discreet design and integrated style. By integrating them into your wall or ceiling, LED panels will provide better lighting while also saving space in your home.

floorLedLights.name: LED Floor Lights
floorLedLights.description: LED floor lights offer durability, efficiency, and mobility. Our LED floor lamps not only complement your primary lighting but can perfectly fit in to enhance and illuminate your interior.

ceilingLedLights.name: LED Ceiling Lights
ceilingLedLights.description: LED ceiling lights provide much brighter lighting with low power consumption. Unlike conventional ceiling lights, they are approximately 90% more efficient and last up to 50 times longer.

ledPendantLights.name: LED Pendant Lights
ledPendantLights.description: Our LED pendant lights offer a contemporary style and energy-efficient technology. The wide range provides lighting for every interior, such as lighting your dining table, complementing your décor and saving money at the same time. Explore our large selection of LED pendant lights with our variety of styles, materials, and colors.

ledWallLights.name: LED Wall Lights
ledWallLights.description: Our LED wall lights offer an energy-efficient and sustainable lighting solution. This product can be adapted and used in many ways to create indirect or direct lighting in your home.

ledTableLights.name: LED Table Lamps
ledTableLights.description: Our collection of LED table lamps is not only functional but can also be used as a decorative element in your home. LED technology provides lighting products that are energy-efficient and eco-friendly.

floorLamps.name: Floor Lamps
floorLamps.description:
Add special lighting to your home and beautify your rooms with our collection of floor lamps. Diverse and modern, allowing you to match the lamp's style to your home.

Whatever your style, you're sure to find the perfect floor lamp for your home. All you need to do is place the floor lamp wherever you like and you're done!

ceilingLights.name: Ceiling Lights
ceilingLights.description:
The ceiling light is one of the most important elements of interior lighting in any room, providing basic lighting and illuminating your interior space.

Create a beautiful atmosphere in your home by combining ceiling lights with other lighting products. We offer a wide range of different designs that complement every décor.

pendantLights.name: Pendant Lights
pendantLights.description:
Pendant lights take center stage as the bright focal point of your room. Our modern and unusual designs offer a unique style for your home.

Our incredible range of pendant lights offers elegant designs. You're sure to find your next standout piece here.

chandeliers.name: Chandeliers
chandeliers.description: Our chandeliers offer a sense of luxury and grandeur. Transform your home and bring sparkle and glamour into your living space.

wallLamps.name: Wall Lights
wallLamps.description:
Wall lights are versatile, practical, and easily adaptable to any space.

Whether you use them to light hallways, bathrooms, as accent lighting, or as reading lamps, we offer a wide range of stylish wall lights.

tableLamps.name: Table Lamps
tableLamps.description:
Whether you're reading or working, enrich your interior lighting with a beautiful table lamp.

Our table lamps offer a range of designs, from classic to the latest trends. Discover new styles using high-quality materials.

trackSpotlights.name: Spotlights
trackSpotlights.description:
Spotlights offer a flexible way to light any room.

Get directional lighting exactly where you need it. Illuminate your home with spotlights and discover our new lighting design options.

recessedSurface.name: Recessed & Surface-Mounted Lights
recessedSurface.description:
Recessed and surface-mounted lights are small, practical, and discreet. Bring light into every room with our spotlights, EGLO's most adaptable and diverse product line.

Equipped with the latest LED technology, you're ready for the future and save a significant amount on electricity costs.

underCabinet.name: Under-Cabinet Lights
underCabinet.description:
You don't want shadows on your work surface while chopping and cutting in the kitchen.

We have the right solution for you! Illuminate your kitchen work surfaces using under-cabinet lighting. Using LED strips involves a very simple installation process — attach, connect, done.

outdoorLights.name: Outdoor Lighting
outdoorLights.description: With outdoor lighting, you can turn your yard into a safe and pleasant space. Our wide range provides the perfect combination of style and functionality, ensuring you enjoy your yard without any worries.

outdoorLedLights.name: Outdoor LED Lights
outdoorLedLights.description:
Want to make the exterior of your home energy-efficient? Simply use our outdoor LED lighting products. Forget traditional lights and adapt to the 21st century.

Do you want your home's outdoor lighting design to be energy-efficient? By using our outdoor LED lights, you're investing in an energy-efficient home.

solarLights.name: Solar Lights
solarLights.description: The advantages of solar lighting are that it's versatile, practical, and sustainable. You don't need any electrical connection. The sun provides all the energy the light needs to operate.

outdoorWallLights.name: Outdoor Wall Lights
outdoorWallLights.description:
Our outdoor wall lights provide an excellent solution for your outdoor lighting needs.

Explore our wide range of wall lights and discover how a combination of colors and materials can enrich the look and functionality of your space.

exteriorCeilingLights.name: Exterior Ceiling Lights
exteriorCeilingLights.description:

Explore our wide range of ceiling lights and discover how a combination of colors and materials can enrich the look and functionality of your space.

outdoorSpotlights.name: Outdoor Spotlights
outdoorSpotlights.description:
Who doesn't love nature? We believe your living space extends beyond your patio door. That's why we offer a wide selection of outdoor lighting products that will highlight the beauty of your garden, adding functionality and practicality.

With EGLO, you can light your garden to your own taste. Thanks to our smart solutions and modern LED technology, you have full control over the atmosphere and lighting.

earthLuminaires.name: Ground Luminaires
earthLuminaires.description: Ground luminaires are the ideal choice for lighting pathways, flower beds, or special parts of the garden. They combine aesthetics and practicality, creating a warm and pleasant atmosphere in your outdoor space.

gardenLights.name: Garden Lights
gardenLights.description: Light up your garden and yard with our collection of garden lights. Create the perfect atmosphere for enjoying the outdoors, adding style and functionality to your outdoor space.

facadeLights.name: Facade Lights
facadeLights.description: Highlight the beauty of your house with our facade lights. Provide safety and aesthetics to the entrances and exterior walls of your home.

pathwayLights.name: Pathway Lights
pathwayLights.description: Light up the paths and walkways in your garden with our collection of pathway lights. Safely and stylishly guide your guests through the outdoor space.

ceilingFans.name: Ceiling Fans
ceilingFans.description:
Want to sustainably improve the indoor climate of your home? Our ceiling fans aren't just a stylish addition — they're also an eco-friendly solution that saves energy and money.

In summer, they create pleasant cooling and bring in fresh air, while in winter they efficiently distribute warm air throughout the room.

ceilingFansWithLight.name: Ceiling Fans with Light
ceilingFansWithLight.description:
Our ceiling fans with light offer lighting, space savings, and air distribution in your home.

Combining functionality with practicality, they light your room and create a pleasant indoor climate.

ceilingFansWithoutLight.name: Ceiling Fans without Light
ceilingFansWithoutLight.description:
Imagine the feel of a light, natural breeze on your skin — almost as if you're outdoors. EGLO's ceiling fan collection is the perfect choice for improving your indoor climate, especially on hot summer days.

Our fans combine modern design, practicality, and high-quality materials for maximum comfort and style.

principles.title: Our principles
principles.pillarsTitle: The pillars of our thinking process
principles.summary: EGLO's development has been, and continues to be, rapid: from the number of employees, through sales growth, to production capacity and sales companies around the world: these growth rates outpace the market, and to ensure EGLO continues to grow in the future, business development is guided by great sustainability. We preserve what has been tried and tested and leave room for our principles to work alongside us.

established.title: Preserving and developing what has proven its worth
established.description:
Our numbers nearly doubled over 10 years (from 2007 to 2017). The number of companies in the EGLO Sales Group grew fivefold over 20 years (1997 to 2017).

The first secret to our success is the fact that EGLO is still a family business and can therefore operate independently. Control over development, production, and logistics has also been a success factor from the very beginning. We learn every day and invest in our customers, our partners, our employees, our products, and our service around the world.

global.title: Global and local
global.description:
Around 70 EGLO companies are responsible for sales, service, and in some cases regional marketing in more than 50 countries worldwide. Despite the progress of internationalization and globalization, we are and remain a family company with Tyrolean roots.

"Think globally, act locally" is increasingly becoming "Ask locally, act globally" as networks and regional needs grow. Customers belong to a regional culture and have different needs, even if they work and shop worldwide. Uniting and reconciling these two worlds is one of our highest aspirations.

light.title: Light that inspires the masses
light.description:
Almost every two hours, a new product is developed at EGLO. That's an average of nearly four new products per working day.

Just last year, more than 900 new products were developed and launched on the market. The current product range includes more than 4,000 items. Every day we produce 80,000 luminaires worldwide.

Even for us, these numbers are always impressive. It takes the ability to listen and a vision to understand what customers want to see and experience in their homes in the future. You can only become a trendsetter if you set the direction yourself. We constantly follow the development of light, life, and life events, absorbing creative impulses from various fields and examining trends for their potential.

organization.title: Strong together
organization.description:
EGLO's rapid growth has always been a challenge for our organization. Our regional-global understanding and the fact that EGLO still is, and will remain, a family business helps us face this challenge. For us, size is an advantage only if things function on a small scale. For this reason, location is essential: for our customers, our partners, and our employees. Only in perfectly organized and well-connected network units can we manage and grow 4,700 employees worldwide.

Another interesting aspect of our organizational philosophy concerns the continuous support of our partners. We constantly take our employees into account, not just the consumer: "What do we need and what can we offer? Where is our experience needed? What do our employees expect and what are our own requirements?" We want to understand and find a common path to success. This is how partnerships are created that will last for decades. This culture is not just part of our organization, but also our personal statement to everyone who works with us.
